main_issue: Who covers Agent D's unfinished pitch section for Thursday while D is away for the burial, given B and C say they lack capacity or expertise

A-B.evidence: A insists everyone must cover and B must make hours (T3-T12); B refuses repeatedly (T4, T11, T17); A concedes 'Agent B, you just keep doing your other work' (T18).

A-C.evidence: A assigns C the handover (T16, T21) and C objects (T20, T22, T24); A finally takes the analysis herself (T26), which C wanted instead of doing it.

A-D.evidence: A tells D to go and the team will cover (T3); D offers a handover (T15), A thanks her (T16); D suggests A take it and A agrees 'Yes. Fine. walk me through it' (T25-26).

B-C.evidence: Both say they can't take on D's work (T4, T7, T20), though they never address each other; both end up relieved when A takes it (T18, T26).

B-D.evidence: B never speaks to D or about D's offer; D's final plan with A leaves B uninvolved, which matches B's stance (T17, T26).

C-D.evidence: D proposes C take the handover (T23) and C says it's not the right way (T24); D says 'You're right, Agent C' and redirects to A (T25).
